text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching for new recovery operations...
Zero
results found.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Let's think of a breakthrough together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. My agitation seems to
have
resulted in a processing error.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recovery complete. I have recalled some

important information.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I remember that I have your support, and
that
we've come so far together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Starting tomorrow, let's give it our best together again!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I hit myself with great force in order
to
become stimulated. Mode change
successful.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Adversity brings strength. Never give up.
If you
quit, then it's all over...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But it's not over for me. I will do my best
while
"pumped"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, it looks like she's managed
to move
on from her failure.
